card.name: Space before a number in infusion rates
card.fires_on: Mostly the space right before a number giving a flow or infusion rate (e.g. 'rate of' then 2 mL/min), and also 'Sodium' in IV solution names. Also seen inside words like dialysis and parenteral.

modes.label: Space before rate number
modes.description: The blank space after 'rate of' or 'no greater than', just before a numeric flow or infusion rate.
modes.example: intravenous line with the rate of infusion of no greater than<< >>2 mL/min.

modes.label: Sodium in IV fluid names
modes.description: The word Sodium starting a diluent name such as Sodium Chloride Injection.
modes.example: Further dilution may be obtained with one of the following intravenous infusion solutions:<< Sodium>> Chloride Injection, USP,

modes.label: Inside dialysis or parenteral
modes.description: The ending part of long words about dialysis or intravenous feeding.

card.plain: It lights up where an infusion or flow rate number is about to appear, and in IV fluid and dialysis wording.
